items.attack_surface: identifier guessing, mass assignment, IDOR, cross-scope search/page/export
items.operator_response: Disable admission, preserve audit evidence, and investigate the affected account and project scopes.

items.attack_surface: stale membership, TOCTOU, lease theft, duplicate delivery, runtime snapshot substitution
prevention_controls: membership version revalidation at side-effect boundaries
items.operator_response: Drain affected workers, retain job and audit rows, rotate lease authority, and replay only safe jobs.

items.attack_surface: Credential envelope, grant or slot confusion, secret in prompt, checkpoint, event, log, audit, or cache
prevention_controls: exact Credential grant and slot revalidation
imperative secret-bearing APIs outside client caches
detective_controls: Credential replacement race and ciphertext assertions
release secret and audit redaction scanners
test_selectors: playwright::tests/e2e/project-assets.spec.ts::project asset authoring, approval, Credential safety, and scope switch
items.operator_response: Stop external calls, rotate the affected Credential, revoke grants, and retain only redacted finding metadata.

items.attack_surface: CSRF, cookie flags, open redirect, unauthenticated admin or project routes, and error detail
test_selectors: playwright::tests/e2e/project-automations.spec.ts::AuthProvider account transition aborts the old list and cannot reuse its cache
items.operator_response: Invalidate active sessions, preserve bounded access logs, and verify public error responses before reopening traffic.

items.attack_surface: file path traversal, symlink, archive traversal, temporary file identity race, and sandbox escape boundary
items.operator_response: Quarantine the owned path or archive, do not follow links, and require a fresh identity-checked recovery run.

items.attack_surface: SSE cursor injection, cross-scope replay, terminal duplication, and Gateway restart
test_selectors: playwright::tests/e2e/project-private-work-isolation.spec.ts::Link project switch drops a late previous-project Thread response
items.operator_response: Stop the affected Gateway, retain frame metadata, and restart from the last verified scoped cursor.

items.attack_surface: Scheduler singleton ownership, manual or automatic admission race, and revoked automation principal
detective_controls: manual idempotency and global cap race
test_selectors: playwright::tests/e2e/project-automations.spec.ts::manual retry reuses one Idempotency-Key after a safe 503 response
items.operator_response: Disable Scheduler admission, verify the ownership lock, and reconcile occurrences before reenabling it.

items.attack_surface: backup tamper, wrong key, journal gap or reorder, source mismatch, restore proof substitution, and deleted-data revival
detective_controls: exact schema and source identity probes
restore proof and deleted-data replay assertions
items.operator_response: Reject the restore target, preserve source and journal evidence, rotate compromised keys, and rerun from a new target.

items.attack_surface: system-admin privilege confusion, support bundle leakage, and readiness metadata enumeration
prevention_controls: system-admin route guard independent of project membership
test_selectors: playwright::tests/e2e/admin-assets.spec.ts::system admin creates an asset and MCP credential slots require approval
items.operator_response: Disable the affected admin surface, regenerate a redacted bundle, and verify role and metadata boundaries before access resumes.
